text:
elaine: ran an overnight canary of kernel-autopick v2 on prod-h100; short-seq workloads (<=32) p50 latency is up ~28% vs baseline. didn't repro on a100. rolled the canary back but want a quick root-cause before we re-deploy.

rob: yikes. looking at the selector traces it picked `fused_matmul_attention` (large-matmul path) for a bunch of short requests. selector heuristic favored throughput for that GRP. attaching perf counters snapshot below.

rob: ```
TIMESTAMP  cpu_ms  sm_eff  cuBLAS_algo  kernel_name
2345678901  4.8    0.92    algoX         fused_matmul_attention
2345678911  3.1    0.75    algoY         small_matmul_attention
2345678922  5.3    0.95    algoX         fused_matmul_attention
```

perf-bot: perfbot: profile uploaded -> https://perf.redwood/internal/artefacts/2345678901-h100-canary-profile (contains nvprof counters + kernel timelines) :mag:

sean: i ran a quick microbench on l4/t4/a10 yesterday; selector picks `small_matmul_attention` for seq<=32 as intended. H100's selector looks like it prefers cuBLAS `algoX` when sm_version >= 90 which biases toward bigger GEMM kernels. numbers from my local bench: h100 small-seq p95 340ms, baseline production (a100) p95 170ms.

chandra: this smells like interaction between KV cache layout and batching/coalescing. if effective sequence (seq + kv-prefix) increases due to cache miss patterns, the selector's seqlen estimate is off and it chooses the wrong kernel. can we check kv hit-rate and effective seqlen distribution from the runtime tracer?

elaine: good call. kv hit-rate for that canary was 0.72 (we normally see ~0.9). so slightly colder cache. i'll re-run a microcanary with `kv_preload=true` to isolate.

rob: quick mitigations we can try today:
1) add an arch-aware preset override: for h100, prefer small-matmul kernel for seq<=64 and disable cuBLAS algo fallback for seq<=32.
2) tweak batching heuristic to consider `kv_effective_seqlen` (seq + avg_kv_miss_penalty).

rob: example preset (quick patch):
```json
{
  "arch": "h100",
  "overrides": {
    "prefer_small_matmul_for_seqlen": 64,
    "disable_cublas_fallback_for_seqlen_le": 32
  },
  "reason": "temporary canary to avoid large-gemm path regressions on cold-KV workloads"
}
```

sean: can we run canary-2 with that preset and 5% traffic? i'll schedule microbench jobs and perfbot will collect counters.

elaine: plan: create canary with preset override, traffic split 5% -> monitor for 30m windows. metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, kv hit-rate, mem-throughput (GB/s), and kernel occupancy. success criteria: p50 delta < 10% vs baseline and no OOMs. if good -> promote; if not -> revert and open incident. pinging @chandra @rob @sean to act. :eyes:

chandra: also add a tracer probe to emit `effective_seqlen` histograms (bin by [<=16, 17-32, 33-64, >64]) so selector telemetry can be correlated.

elaine: will add tracer probe and update the canary PR. thanks all.
